bearingSource: OSM way 206525143 long axis 154.5°; +X points to the street front with the central risalit and the double stair (OSM projection on that side; photos 03, 07).
approximations: Plan after the OSM outline (19.0 m wide); the lower rear wing on the −Z side (≈6.5 m beyond the OSM outline) added after drone photos 01, 02 and 07. Heights estimated (cornice 6.9 m, mansard curb 9.8 m, central pavilion ≈12.4 m, tower spire ≈16.3 m). Window rhythm of the +Z side and the rear partly inferred; ox-eye dormer count per side estimated; stucco ornament reduced to blocks, scrolls and discs; dome profiles approximated; diamond zinc shingles shown as a diagonal grid.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografiile de referință și conturul OSM; ornamentația din stuc, numărul ferestrelor de pe fațadele laterale și posterioară și profilul domurilor sunt simplificate, iar șindrila romboidală din zinc este redată ca rețea diagonală.
note.hu: A referenciafotók és az OSM-körvonal alapján értelmezett makett; a stukkódíszek, az oldal- és hátsó homlokzatok ablakszáma és a kupolák profilja egyszerűsített, a rombusz alakú cinkzsindely átlós hálóként jelenik meg.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from the reference photographs and the OSM outline; stucco ornament, window counts on the side and rear elevations and the dome profiles are simplified, and the diamond-shaped zinc shingles are shown as a diagonal grid.
